newsitem.title: USA: James River, Ft. Howard meet gov't request.
newsitem.headline: James River, Ft. Howard meet gov't request.

text.p: James River Corp said Monday that on July 3 it and Fort Howard Corp certified their compliance with the U.S. Department of Justice's request for additional information relating to their proposed merger.

The company said that the Department of Justice request was issued on June 6. Substantial compliance with the "second request" starts the 20 calendar day waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act, unless otherwise extended by the parties, it said.
James River added that both companies have already fixed August 12 as the date for special shareholder meetings to approve the merger.
